entities.summary: Ute Meta Bauer is a German curator based in Singapore. She is an international curator, professor of contemporary art and was the founding director of the Centre for Contemporary Art (CCA) in Singapore. Ute Meta Bauer was a authors & novelists from Stuttgart (b. 1958-05-24, Stuttgart). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
